g.text: Finite-element models across several physics domains, composable for coupled multi-physics.
Hover a model for details · click to open its documentation
Solves for the electric potential in conductors and dielectrics under prescribed
voltages and charges. Gives electric fields, capacitance matrices, stored energy, and
Capacitance extraction · high-voltage insulation and field grading · MEMS actuators
Magnetostatics and transient eddy currents in the time domain. Handles nonlinear B–H
curves, permanent magnets, superconductors, and coils driven by current, voltage, or a
Electric motors and generators · actuators and solenoids · transformers · eddy-current
Low-frequency magnetic fields as complex phasors at one frequency. Resolves eddy
currents, skin and proximity effects, and AC losses in a single solve, without
Induction heating · AC losses in windings and busbars · wireless power transfer ·
Full-wave electromagnetics in the time domain. Follows pulses and broadband signals as
they propagate, reflect, and radiate, and gives the response over a wide frequency
Broadband antennas and S-parameters · pulsed power · signal integrity ·
Full-wave electromagnetics in the frequency domain, including displacement currents
and wave propagation. Gives fields, resonances, S-parameters at ports, and far-field
Antennas · waveguides and cavity filters · RF and microwave components · photonic
Heat conduction in solids with volumetric heat sources, convection, radiation, heat
flux, and phase change. Joule and eddy-current losses from the electromagnetic models
Thermal management of motors, coils, and electronics · induction heating · welding ·
Linear elastic deformation of solids under body forces, tractions, and fixed
displacements. Gives displacements, strains, and von Mises stress; Maxwell stresses
from the electromagnetic models act as surface loads.
Motor housings and supports · magnetic bearings · deformation under electromagnetic
Viscous incompressible flow, steady or transient. Gives velocity and pressure fields
and the forces and heat fluxes at walls, for liquids and low-speed gas flows.
Cooling of electrical machines, coils, and power electronics · pipe and channel flow ·
Phase transformations in steels and alloys during heating and cooling. Tracks the
austenite, ferrite, pearlite, bainite, and martensite fractions from the temperature
history, with latent heat fed back to the thermal model.
Heat treatment and quenching · induction hardening · welding heat-affected zones ·
